# Preface {.unnumbered}

This is a working draft of a textbook built from the lectures for GEOG 215, Spatial Data Science.

Every chapter is a runnable Quarto document. The R code in each chapter runs when the book is built, so the tables and maps you see come from the code printed beside them.

## Before you start

Several chapters download data from web APIs. For the US Census chapters, request a free API key at <https://api.census.gov/data/key_signup.html> and store it once:

```r
tidycensus::census_api_key("YOUR KEY HERE", install = TRUE)
```

This saves the key to your `.Renviron` file, so it never needs to appear in your scripts.
